registered_at: 2026-10-02 evening ET, before any variant was computed
question: Does any one-parameter change to the live overnight book beat the live configuration on the 10-year panel?

base_live_config.rank: 12-1 momentum cf[t-21]/cf[t-252]-1, chosen at the close of t, held close t -> open t+1 (ON[t+1])
base_live_config.intraday_filter: drop picks with c[t]/o[t]-1 < -1% (live uses the 15:40 price; the close is a slight look-ahead, same for every variant); dropped names are not replaced

cost: 2 bp per side (auction), 4 bp per night on the deployed book; identical across variants, so ranking uses gross

variants.IVOL: weights proportional to 1 / 60-day sd of daily returns
variants.F_0: keep only names up on the day (>= 0%)
variants.SPY_SKIP: hold nothing on nights when SPY's day (open->close) is below -1%

statistic: paired nightly difference variant minus base (bp/night, gross), mean and t over nights; SPY_SKIP scored as 0 on skipped nights
pass: OOS mean diff >= +2 bp/night with t >= 3.0 (Bonferroni for 17 variants) AND IS diff same sign with t >= 1.5
lean: OOS t >= 2.0 and IS same sign: report, do not ship; re-check on the next 6 months
also_report: per-variant gross/net bp/night IS and OOS, % green nights, worst night, names held
